_comment: THE field index. Every field that crosses a module or runtime boundary is declared here exactly once: key (= storage name), label, type, path, owner, old names (aliases), GSSM cell (Excel A1) and iSBD labels. Loaders: core/shared/field_index.py (Flask) and frontend/src/shared/constants/fieldIndex.js (React). FIELD_REGISTRY.md is generated from this file. Phase codes and service areas live in domain_constants.json.

owners.deal: Entered in s0L (Home, Deal Details, wizard, iSBD). Stored on the deal.
owners.gssm: Produced by the GSSM workbook and stored verbatim. Written only by PUT /api/deals/:id/gssm-sync.
owners.monday: Produced by the monday.com deal board and stored as the board has it. Stored only by core/features/integrations/monday/writer.py: by the board sync, after a TT Exec changes a column marked 's0L writes' on the board (a name the column already has, each change confirmed), and when the New Deal form adds a row (stored as monday answers).
owners.salesforce: Produced by IBM's Salesforce (IBM Sales Cloud) and stored as Salesforce has it. Stored only by core/features/integrations/salesforce/writer.py, by the Salesforce check of the deals on the monday board. A field that is deal-editable stays editable in s0L until Salesforce supplies a value for it; a blank in Salesforce never overwrites one.
owners.derived: Computed from other fields. Never stored; read-only everywhere.
